detail.longDescription: As information becomes easier to access, understanding and judgment matter more than ever. Xmind 2027 gives you and AI a shared visual space to work through ideas. With Xmind Agent, use your local documents and maps to research, develop ideas, and weigh possibilities through conversation. Your map evolves with your thinking. With MCP, bring that same context into ChatGPT, Claude, and your existing AI workflow, while you stay in control of the direction.
